parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, assays on activities.assay_id, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1873', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606, target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
